# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file mobile browser canvas game called **Jingle Kart Snow Dash**. Preserve the mechanics of a fixed-screen survival shooter: pointer-drag movement, auto-fire while touching/holding the playfield, upward projectiles, falling hazards that split into smaller hazards when hit, tiered score awards, score-derived phase labels, collision-triggered game over, and restart. Reinterpret it as a pseudo-3D Christmas kart race: a red-and-mint antler Jingle Kart races along a snowy North Pole track, fires candy-cane boosts, bursts wrapped gift hazards, earns Cheer, and spins out on collision. Use procedural canvas art, Bangers/Rajdhani fonts, mobile-safe HUD chips, scoped canvas pointer handling, and lightweight WebAudio chimes.
gamezone-34c63716-4569-4f8a-8b34-355250d.blueprint:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: Mobile-first fixed-screen canvas arcade shooter / survival game.
- objective: Hold and drag on the playfield to steer, auto-fire upward projectiles, destroy descending hazards, and survive as score rises.
- input model: Pointer/touch down and drag on canvas controls avatar target; auto-fire occurs only while input is active; start/restart are native buttons.
- core loop: Spawn falling large hazards, shoot them, split them into smaller hazards, award score by hazard tier, increase pressure through score-driven spawn pacing.
- fail/friction state: Player collision with any hazard immediately triggers game-over overlay and restart path; missed hazards are removed after leaving the screen.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve pointer-drag movement, active-hold auto-fire, projectile travel, falling/splitting hazard behavior, tiered score awards, score-derived phase labels, collision game-over, and restart.

## Remix Interpretation
The protected shooter loop is reframed as a pseudo-3D Christmas kart dash. The player is a toy Jingle Kart on a snowy North Pole track firing candy-cane boosts at rolling gift hazards. The score becomes Cheer and the phase label becomes Cup Lap.

# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first browser arcade game titled **Frost Kart Gift Dash**. Preserve the source mechanic truth: targets spawn at the top and drift downward; a direct tap on a target marks it as activated and accelerates it; a second tap removes it and awards exactly +100; if any target reaches the bottom gate the run ends; restart resets score and entities. Rebuild the presentation as a pseudo-3D Christmas kart race with Santa's sleigh kart at the bottom, elf/snowman toy karts as targets, candy-cane gate failure line, snowy mountain track, pine trees, gifts, falling snow, race HUD, and playful arcade fonts/audio.

# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: simple mobile arcade tap-defense game on a canvas.
- objective: prevent descending targets from crossing the bottom gate while gaining points.
- input model: direct pointer/touch taps on moving targets; UI buttons start and restart.
- core loop: spawn target, target drifts downward, first tap activates/accelerates it, second tap removes it for +100, repeat until a target breaches the bottom threshold.
- fail/friction state: any target reaching the bottom danger line triggers immediate game over and restart overlay.

## Protected Mechanics
- Timed spawning, falling movement, two-tap target lifecycle, tap-radius collision, +100 scoring on second tap only, score phase labels, bottom-line failure, restart reset, and canvas-only gameplay `preventDefault`.

## Remix Blueprint
The game is regenerated as **Frost Kart Gift Dash**, a pseudo-3D Christmas kart race where Santa’s sleigh-kart marshal clears runaway toy racers before they block the candy-cane finish gate. The same tap and scoring mechanics are preserved while all safe presentation surfaces become snowy kart track, rival elf/snowman karts, turbo boost feedback, race HUD, and festive audio.
